component.name: Deltos
component.summary: Turn photos of documents into flat, upright, correctly-sized scans

description.p: Deltos is a desktop document scanner that needs no scanner. Photograph a document at any angle and it returns a flat, upright page with its real physical dimensions, ready to export as PDF, PNG or JPG.
Each photo goes through the same pipeline:

ul.li: The page is found with a neural detector and classic edge detection together, so it works on cluttered desks as well as clean ones.
Its true proportions are recovered from the perspective, using the focal length recorded by the camera.
Its physical size comes from a reference card beside it, the camera's depth measurement, or the standard paper size it matches — and the source of that number is always shown.
The page is rectified, its lighting evened out in colour, grayscale or black and white, and turned upright.
Its text can be recognised, selected with the mouse and copied, in as many languages as are installed.

description.p: Photos can also be sent straight from a phone over the local network, and everything the interface does is available from the command line.
